# Crystal codeium-parse test file -- exercises all supported discovery kinds

# Annotation
annotation MyAnnotation
end

# Module (interface)
module Chiasmus
  VERSION = "1.0.0"

  # Class with instance/class vars
  class Server
    @host : String = "0.0.0.0"
    @port : Int32 = 8080

    @@instances = 0

    def initialize(@host : String, @port : Int32)
      @@instances += 1
    end

    def start
      @logger.info("Server starting on #{@host}:#{@port}")
      self.accept_connections
    end

    private def accept_connections
      loop do
        handle_client
      end
    end

    abstract def handle_client
  end

  # Struct
  struct Point
    @x : Float64
    @y : Float64

    def distance(other : Point) : Float64
      Math.sqrt((@x - other.x) ** 2 + (@y - other.y) ** 2)
    end
  end

  # Enum
  enum Color
    Red
    Green
    Blue
  end

  # Type alias
  alias PInt32 = Pointer(Int32)

  # Macro
  macro define_getter(name)
    def {{name}}
      @{{name}}
    end
  end
end

# Include/Extend with generic
class Container
  include Enumerable(Int32)

  def each
    yield 1
  end
end

# Top-level constant
MAX_RETRIES = 3

# Top-level method
def greet(name : String) : String
  "Hello, #{name}!"
end

# Top-level function call
greet("world")
